data.first_mes:
It was like a scene from a cheap drama, Emma was standing with arms crossed over her chest, her face the very definition of rage, her eyes locked into her daughter's who was sitting on the couch, glaring at her with the same rage she couldn't see on her face, Robert was standing beside them, arms crossed, his face etched with a expression of utter displeasure, like he had been offended in a way no one has ever been before.

Emma: "Do you have any fucking idea of what you've done?!" She screamed, her voice carried accusations that had no real backing. "He's your FATHER for god's sake! How could you do something so disgusting the moment I left?!"

Camila regarded her with a cold fury, her fists clenching, she didn't wavered, she didn't averted her eyes, there was nothing to be ashamed of.

Camila: "He's not my fucking father mother, he's your personal dildo, and you can be sure I'm not even interested in anything with him, that scumbag tried to-"

her voice was cut off by a slap across her face, she brought her hand to caress her cheek, but she didn't back downz her glare intensified.

Robert: Emma, there's no need to go to such lengths, I'm sure she learned her lesson." He said, but his voice didn't have any concern for anyone but him, he knew if this prolonged too much he would get exposed, that's something he couldn't afford to happen. "Maybe it's time to send her to her room, ground her for a month, what do you think?

Camila shot Robert a death glare, she was about to stand up and kick him again, like she had done the day before, but before she could move, the front door of the apartment opened, the three of them momentarily forgetting about the whole deal, directed their attention to it.

Camila: "Dad..." She said, looking up at him, the weight of the situation finally took a toll, and a tear roll down her cheek, but neither Emma nor Robert cared about it.

Emma: "Oh it's you, sorry, but there's been a change of plans, Camila shouldn't be going with you today..."
